title: INTRODUCTION TO ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
description: Fundamental concepts in artificial intelligence using the unifying theme of an intelligent agent. Topics include agent architectures, search, games, logic and reasoning, and Bayesian networks.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CS 325 or 325H.
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 325 and CS 325H.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Elect & Computer Engineering (039) or Computer Science (307).

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
